blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26108096 the implementation remained 0x2b7074cf6681382b70e239063931ebe83c0f4e0a. Its verified code has BLACKLISTER_ROLE, ENFORCER_ROLE, native blacklist checks, inherited USDat freeze checks and a seize function moving shares from blacklisted holders. Saturn's terms section 9 explicitly acknowledges a seize mechanism in USDat and sUSDat. BNB and Monad SaturnOFT representations enforce restricted transfers and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE recoverFunds; allowlistMode() returned 1 on both at blocks 125385350 and 110032586. These are direct holder-control powers, not an inference from mint roles or centralized governance.

oracleRisk.summary: Exact STRConModule oracle() is 0x8201ff053bb7c96c10fb9611934c14142b2702de. Wrapper primaryFeed=0xc353ac4b425f818ad87e228bf816e15c2173ac07, referenceFeed=0x67d4ae9f265270ae123c08d2657536771d19cd91, syntheticSharesOracle=0x9bc39db6fbb44b91a48b8d5a6c208b82b1741be6. Immutable wrapper validates rounds, positive answers, synthetic share value/paused state and $20–150 underlying bounds; current reference-age bound is 93600 seconds (26h), deviation 100 bps, versus hard maxima 36h/1000bps. Primary round age has no equivalent elapsed-time bound, and the reference is a circuit breaker, never a fallback returned price. getPrice() reverted FeedDeviation (0xc7f602ab) at block 26110187: guard activity is verified but NAV is unavailable, not zero. Vault PARAMETER_MANAGER_ROLE can alter bounds/deviation/reference-age within caps and STRConModule.setOracle can replace this wrapper under the current one-hour timelock. EACAggregatorProxy feeds remain owner-replaceable upstream; their complete signer and heartbeat census is not established. This is top-level credit-vault NAV pricing, not a borrower liquidation system.
